title: THE ANGEL IS HERE RIGHT NOW

lines.text: The Angel is here right now,
The Angel is here right now,
He is here to meet your need,
And to set the captive free,
O the Angel is here right now.
King Jesus is here right now,
King Jesus is here right now,
He is here to meet your need,
And to set the captive free,
O Jesus is here right now.
